title: Patient Payment Plan Payment-Record Ceiling for Re-aged Schedules
content:
**Rule.** The longest re-aged schedule of a **Patient Payment Plan** may run past the tier's maximum term only as far as the payment-record ceiling allows, which follows the installment payment entries numbered 1 or more posted on the plan (each entry counts, a partial payment included; the down payment, numbered 0, does not): 60 installments for at least 3 such entries and 48 installments for at least 1 but fewer than 3, each only on tiers whose maximum term is shorter; otherwise the payment-record ceiling is the tier's maximum term.

| Tier | Tier maximum term | 3 or more entries | 1 or 2 entries | No entries |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Riverbend Short-Term Payment Plan | 6 | 60 | 48 | 6 |
| Riverbend Standard Payment Plan | 12 | 60 | 48 | 12 |
| Riverbend Extended Payment Plan | 24 | 60 | 48 | 24 |
| Riverbend Long-Term Payment Plan | 36 | 60 | 48 | 36 |
| Riverbend Assistance-Linked Payment Plan | 48 | 60 | 48 | 48 |
| Riverbend Hardship Payment Plan | 60 | 60 | 60 | 60 |

**Both sides.** With 2 entries the ceiling on a 24-installment tier is 48; a third entry raises it to 60. With no entry numbered 1 or more, the ceiling is the tier's maximum term.
